description: This PHP source file defines the VueControllerException class within the OrangeHRM project's core controller exception namespace. It extends the base Exception class and provides a static method to generate a specific exception message indicating a request has already been handled.

classes.name: VueControllerException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating errors related to Vue controller actions, specifically representing an error when a request has already been handled.

methods.name: alreadyHandled
methods.description: Static factory method returning an instance of VueControllerException with a predefined message indicating a request has already been processed and cannot modify the component.

calls: new self("Request already handled, cannot change the component")
